description: Quick redact list entries and patterns (#1618, round 2 of #1631, U8): the same inputs for the editor's C++ validator (tests/unit/test_text_protocol.cpp) and the MCP server (tests/integration/test_mcp.py). Rules, in order. Terms: a raw line break (\n, \r, U+2028, U+2029) is refused; then the value is trimmed; it must be non-empty, at most 100 code points, and contain a letter or digit. Patterns: a raw line break is refused; then trimmed, it must be non-empty, at most 500 code points, not start with (*, and not contain \C; the raw value must compile, not match empty text, not refer back to a group (backreferences, recursion, subroutine calls), and not repeat without a bound a group that itself holds an unbounded repeat (unless every pass of the group starts or ends with a required character that its inner repeats cannot match). Rules compile, emptyMatch, backReference and nestedRepeat need PCRE2; a checker that has no PCRE2 may leave them to the editor. A compile error is Qt's message with its offset, so its rows give only errorPrefix.
